content: Figure FIGREF11 contains the results for speculation detection and scope resolution for models trained jointly on multiple datasets. We observe that training on multiple datasets helps the performance of all models on each dataset, as the quantity of data available to train the model increases. We also observe that XLNet consistently outperforms BERT and RoBERTa. To confirm this observation, we apply the 2 models to the related task of negation detection and scope resolution
